value.rationale: The arbitrary-base structural replacement principle gives a closed form and contact certificate for a natural infinite class of asymmetric, nonsmooth homothetic frusta, reducing a dimension-higher metric optimization to one base Löwner ellipsoid. It strictly extends the published circular and simplex-base cases and contrasts the opposite John-ellipsoid transition. No unsubstantiated applications or universal optimality beyond this natural class are claimed.
